summary: SMX (Security Matters) Public Ltd Co filed a Form 6-K announcing a 20:1 reverse stock split effective May 11, 2026, reducing outstanding shares from ~12 million to ~614,000. No fractional shares will be issued; instead, aggregated fractional entitlements will be sold at market. The company amended its constitution to adjust par value. No shareholder approval was needed following a May 2025 authorization. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or any other event-driven category. Risk-arb and special-situations monitors should disregard this as a non-event.
